findings.detail: GUR was authored under constitution 1.7 and is revalidated under 1.8, not trusted on its declared version. 1.8 is not purely permissive over 1.7: it fixes citation cardinality at one locus per edge (DEC-2026-0008) and settles MODIFIES vs DERIVED_FROM for table lookups (DEC-2026-0011). Rows that were valid under 1.7 may fail here.
